offering_description.value: Genco transports unpackaged commodities by sea for producers, commodity traders and industrial companies. It operates a fleet of dry bulk vessels and carries cargo under voyage and time charters.

primary_services.value: ocean freight for dry bulk cargo; time chartering of crewed bulk carriers

customer_segment.value: B2B: mining companies, commodity traders, steelmakers, grain exporters and other industrial shippers

end_markets.value: mining and metals; steelmaking; power generation; agriculture; construction materials

revenue_model.value: project or contract: freight for carrying dry bulk cargo on agreed voyages; rental or leasing: daily hire for crewed bulk carriers under time charters
revenue_model.category: project or contract; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates bulk carriers that take on dry commodities for producers and traders; service provider: arranges and delivers ocean transport for commodity shippers and industrial charterers

geography_served.value: global: international dry bulk routes across the Atlantic, Pacific and Indian oceans

specialization.value: niche specialist: dry bulk ocean shipping for iron ore, coal, grain and other bulk commodities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house commercial team working with commodity shippers and charterers; agents / brokers: shipbrokers who arrange vessel charters

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: vessel safety and pollution rules under IMO conventions including SOLAS and MARPOL, enforced by flag and port states

divestiture_lines: P1.9: As one of the largest drybulk shipping companies in the world, Genco recognizes the need to run a safe and responsible business built for the long-term. We regularly integrate Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) practices into our operational and strategic decision making. As such, we aim to meet and, if possible and appropriate for our business, exceed minimum compliance levels set forth in rules and regulations governing the maritime industry. Over the last several years, we have taken various steps to reduce our carbon footprint and improve the environment, which includes purchasing modern, fuel-efficient vessels while divesting of older less fuel-efficient tonnage, among other important investments made to our sizeable fleet. Download our ESG Sustainability Report for further detail regarding key initiatives executed by the Genco team.

P2.10: Given the importance of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) factors to management and Genco’s diverse stakeholders, near and long-term ESG objectives are increasingly reflected in our strategic decision-making process. We continue to invest in our fleet through the purchase of modern, fuel-efficient vessels while divesting older, less fuel-efficient tonnage with a key goal of reducing emissions and are committed to meeting or exceeding the IMO’s greenhouse gas emissions reduction targets.
